summary.text: Ted Davis, Jr. is a Republican member of the North Carolina House of Representatives, representing District 20 (New Hanover County), for the 2025-2026 session. The General Assembly's member page lists 7.5 terms served in the House.

paragraphs.text: The General Assembly's member page lists Ted Davis, Jr.'s occupation as Retired Attorney.
